page_title: ACM 1-0 LAZ | AC Milan v Lazio 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' Giuseppe Collu is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+13' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+12' Here’s the VAR verdict on that penalty incident – NO PENALTY for Lazio! Play can continue.
90+7' Referee Giuseppe Collu has finally had enough of Massimiliano Allegri and gives him a straight RED CARD!
90+6' Referee Giuseppe Collu makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lazio. Let’s see what happens!
90+5' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

90+5' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lazio.

90+3' Pedro (Lazio) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee is firm and issues Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) a deserved yellow card.
89' The fouls committed statistics – 8:10.

85' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Ivan Provedel who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
85' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Luca Pellegrini and he is replaced by Nuno Tavares (Lazio).
85' Substitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) in, Toma Basic out.
84' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle after Adam Marusic (Lazio) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to AC Milan.

84' Toma Basic (Lazio) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range low towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Nkunku departs the field of play to be replaced by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan).
82' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) offside.
81' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) approaches the edge of the box with intent and shoots, but Ivan Provedel rushes out to narrow the angle and smothers the ball. Good goalkeeping!
78' A cross from Pedro (Lazio) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
76' The corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is intercepted by the defence.

76' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lazio will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
75' The resulting corner from Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is cleared by the defence.

75' The defensive wall stood firm and easily blocked the powerfully hit free kick from Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) on the edge of the box. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.
72' Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.

71' What an opportunity! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the bottom left corner, but Mike Maignan reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pedro (Lazio) for Gustav Isaksen.
69' The total number of attempts is 12:5. 2:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.

67' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) outmuscles the defender near the penalty spot and get his head to a cross from Davide Bartesaghi. The accuracy is lacking, however, and the ball spins well wide of the right post.
65' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
65' It's time for a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) comes on in place of Youssouf Fofana.
64' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
63' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Ivan Provedel, who pulls off a stunning save!
62' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Boulaye Dia is replaced by Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
62' Substitution. Matias Vecino is replaced by Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio).
61' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
61' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
57' This is a yellow card! Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
55' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
54' Toma Basic (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
51' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Fikayo Tomori is the provider as he slips the ball to Rafael Leao (AC Milan) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:0.
51' That's unlucky! Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
50' Lazio are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
49' Toma Basic received a clever long ball from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
48' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is caught off guard a bit when the ball lands at his feet, causing him to rush a first-time shot that is easily blocked by an opposition player.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) wastes a huge opportunity from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the left post.
41' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Poor challenge! Matias Vecino (Lazio) is penalised for tripping and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle.
36' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is able to continue to play.
33' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the left post is smartly dealt with by Mike Maignan.
31' Total attempts – 3:2. The current number of shots on goal is 0:1.
30' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
30' The ball is cleared after Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
26' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
22' A pass into the penalty area from Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is intercepted by the defence.
20' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
18' The percentage of ball possession is – 51:49.
17' Adam Marusic (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
17' Toma Basic (Lazio) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
16' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
14' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle. Adam Marusic (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play.
13' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

13' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. It will be a corner kick for Lazio.
9' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
7' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
6' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
5' Mario Gila (Lazio) brings his opponent down. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
4' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box and fires the ball goalwards. His attempt is blocked by one of his teammates, though, and ricochets away off him.
2' The corner kick from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

2' A cross from the free kick finds its way to Mario Gila (Lazio) in front of goal and he steers a bullet header towards the roof of the net. Mike Maignan pulls off a fabulous save and denies him, parrying the ball onto the bar. Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.
1' A clumsy foul by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle. Lazio are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Lazio will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Giuseppe Collu got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
